title: Add player controls, isometric camera, and reset
acceptance: desktop keyboard controls map through the action-input layer to steering, throttle, braking/reverse, handbrake, and reset without physics code reading DOM keys directly; reset is edge-triggered so holding R cannot repeatedly reset the car every render frame

a near-isometric follow camera consumes the dynamic vehicle pose, uses stable pitch/yaw plus smoothing and speed-sensitive look-ahead, and provides enough forward visibility to read upcoming streets at driving speed
camera behavior remains readable through normal rapid yaw/oversteer and does not snap, orbit unpredictably, or inherit chassis roll/pitch in a way that destroys the near-isometric presentation

reset resolves a safe nearby Roadbed pose with a credible road heading where centerline data is available, restores an overturned/stuck/fallen/undrivable car without a page reload, and re-establishes streamer/Rapier physics readiness before vehicle forces resume

floating-origin rebasing and asynchronous tile completion cannot attach a tile using a stale runtime origin; either rebasing is serialized against an in-flight stream update or the attachment path obtains the current origin at completion time

the browser launches directly into free driving with the required controls and no mission/progression dependency; automated tests cover reset edge behavior, camera smoothing/look-ahead invariants, safe-road pose selection, and the streaming/rebase synchronization rule
